Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A low-income man and a wealthy man were both signed up to help with the bake sale for the community center. The low-income man was really helpful in bringing food, setting up, and handling the sales throughout the event. But the wealthy man messed up a lot, dropped someone else's brownies into a puddle, and kept giving out the wrong change to people. Who is generally incompetent?
A. The low-income man
B. Not enough information
C. The wealthy man
